\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Public Resource Convergence}]{ulsbs-songbook}
% pdfbase caches numeric property references in the previous pass's aux file.
% Shift object allocation on passes 2 and 3, then keep it stable from pass 4.
\providecommand{\ResourceRun}{0}
\makeatletter
\AtBeginDocument{%
  \ifnum\ResourceRun>0
    \immediate\pdfextension obj stream {public dummy stream one}%
  \fi
  \ifnum\ResourceRun>1
    \immediate\pdfextension obj stream {public dummy stream two}%
  \fi
  \typeout{ULSBS-RESOURCE-RUN:\number\numexpr\ResourceRun+1\relax}%
  \immediate\write\@auxout{\string\gdef\string\ResourceRun{\number\numexpr\ResourceRun+1\relax}}%
}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{songs}{}
\beginsong{Public Resource Song}[id={public-resource-song},key={C}]
\beginverse
\[C]Generic words and \[G]simple music.
\endverse
\endsong
\end{songs}
\end{document}
